title: Contra Advance: The Alien Wars EX

match.zip: Contra Advance - The Alien Wars EX.zip

rows: Lock position (aim in 8 ways while standing)
Switch between the two held weapons
Shoot in all directions; R spins the soldier

widgets.text: Unlike the SNES original there are no smart bombs and only one weapon slot is lost on death, so switch to the weaker gun before risky jumps.

Crush the arms of the first-stage giant turtle from the left wall; in the overhead stages circle the boss while firing the spread or homing gun; against the final heart, stay low and keep the laser on the core between waves.
widgets.title: Tips

rows: Machine gun: rapid fire, the safe default
Laser: piercing beam, good on bosses
Homing missiles: track enemies, good in overhead stages

widgets.text: Contra Advance has no collectibles: the reward is finishing on Hard for the extra ending. Score points come from enemies; extra lives come at score milestones.
Passwords are given after each stage (Normal mode); write them down to continue.
